query: WITH gone AS ( DELETE FROM dictation_audio a USING dictation_sessions s WHERE s.id = a.session_id AND s.created_at < now() - make_interval(hours => $1) RETURNING a.session_id) UPDATE dictation_sessions s SET audio_deleted_at = now(), status = CASE WHEN s.status IN ('saved', 'rejected') THEN s.status ELSE 'abandoned' END, transcript = CASE WHEN s.status = 'saved' THEN s.transcript END, draft = CASE WHEN s.status = 'saved' THEN s.draft END FROM gone WHERE s.id = gone.session_id
